leaf_cluster_summaries.summary: US initial jobless claims fell to 206K for the week ending August 15, coming in below the estimated 210K, indicating continued resilience in the labor market.
Micron announces plans to invest $10 billion over the next 10 years to build a memory research laboratory in the United States.
The Philly Fed Manufacturing index reached 47.4, its best level since April 2021, while the prices paid sub-index fell to 40.9, marking its lowest range since early 2025.
Walmart's CEO highlights continued growth from higher-income households and a 70% increase in customers using its AI tool Sparky, who spend 40% more per order.
Federal Reserve's Mary Daly states that rising long-term bond yields are a global issue that blunts policy signals, while asserting that Fed credibility is not at risk.
